name: Devin
description: Cognition's autonomous AI software engineer; API to create and manage Devin sessions, knowledge, playbooks and org resources.
access_notes: Self-serve signup at app.devin.ai with Free, Pro ($20/mo), Max ($200/mo) and Teams ($80/mo min) plans. API credentials (cog_-prefixed service-user keys or PATs) are generated from Settings > Service users / the Devin API settings page.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP server at https://mcp.devin.ai/mcp with Bearer auth (cog_ keys only; legacy apk_ keys unsupported), documented at docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/devin-mcp. No Composio toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/devin returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: Did not verify whether the Free tier includes API/service-user key creation or whether a paid plan is effectively required for meaningful API usage (sessions consume paid quota/credits). No webhook/event-subscription docs found in the v3 API reference searches; left as null. WebSocket refers to the ACP live endpoint accepting PATs.

evidence.note: Principal + token model: Service User API Keys and Personal Access Tokens, all cog_-prefixed, sent as Authorization: Bearer
PATs used identically in Authorization header against api.devin.ai/v3; also accepted by the ACP live WebSocket endpoint
Official Devin MCP server at https://mcp.devin.ai/mcp; requires cog_ API key, optional X-Org-Id header for enterprise/PAT tokens
'Devin has four self-serve plans you can sign up for directly at app.devin.ai': Free, Pro $20/mo, Max $200/mo, Teams $80/mo minimum
Current v3 REST API is org- and enterprise-scoped covering sessions, service users, roles and more, with cursor pagination and RBAC
